notes: `חֳדָשִׁים` → *new moons* and `מֹּעֲדִים` → *set feasts* are headed on the specifying word, because *moons* and *feasts* alone name any moon and any feast; rule 31's class-noun tie-breaker does not reach them, since the ASV writes neither noun alone in this verse or passage or as its ordinary rendering of these words. The competing readings head on *moons* and *feasts*.
`עֹלוֹת` → *burnt offerings* heads on *burnt*, which rule 31 rules explicitly.
`לִפְנֵי` fuses with its construct noun into one English word, headed on the construct (rules 23, 30).
